questionText:

Statement I: Henri Fayol's principles are applicable at top-level management, whereas F.W. Taylor's principles apply primarily to the shop-floor operational level.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

detailedSolution:

1. Statement I is true: Fayol developed a top-down administrative model, whereas Taylor focused bottom-up at the shop-floor.
